decisions.reason: After surviving its first two selling seasons without any visible negative signal, this close-to-core track spotlight line still supports the firm's modular portfolio and now looks more like a proven option than a candidate for withdrawal.

The ceiling luminaire remains tightly aligned with the firm's established offer and channels, and with no evidence of weak acceptance the value of retaining a broad design-led range still outweighs the modest cost of keeping it.

As a 2024 launch close to the core business, the flexible LED spotlight is still in the learning phase, so real-options logic favors keeping the option open while market feedback continues to develop.

This canopy builds directly on the firm's existing lighting systems, and because such complementary components are relatively inexpensive to maintain yet valuable for system completeness, it is sensible to keep it.

The low-voltage canopy is a somewhat narrower system extension, but it still fits the firm's modular offering and should be retained while demand uncertainty remains unresolved and carrying costs appear limited.

Although the round glass track luminaires appear more tentative in the website presentation and may be a more style-sensitive niche, they are still new and close enough to the core range that the firm would likely preserve the option for now rather than exit immediately.
